scripts.verify: npm run verify:runtime && npm run verify:workspace && npm run verify:submodules
scripts.build: npm -w intrastructure run build && npm -w hson-live run build && npm -w hson-demo2 run build
scripts.check: npm -w hson-live run check && npm -w hson-live run check:entrypoints && npm run verify:package-surface && npm -w hson-demo2 run check && npm -w hson-demo2 run check:cloudflare
scripts.preflight:worker: npm run verify && npm run build && npm run check
scripts.deploy:worker: npm run preflight:worker && npm -w hson-demo2 run preflight:cloudflare && npm -w hson-demo2 run cloudflare:deploy
scripts.sync:demo2: git -C hson-demo2 fetch origin && git -C hson-demo2 switch main && git -C hson-demo2 merge --ff-only origin/main && git add hson-demo2 && (git diff --cached --quiet -- hson-demo2 || git commit -m "Bump hson-demo2" -- hson-demo2)
scripts.verify:demo2: test "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse HEAD)" = "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse origin/main)" && test "$(git ls-tree HEAD hson-demo2 | awk '{print $3}')" = "$(git -C hson-demo2 rev-parse HEAD)"
